property_summary: Only the admin (the deployer of C) can successfully call setOwner; any other caller causes it to revert, and when it succeeds owner equals the provided address and returns true.
Calling setOwner either reverts (if caller is not admin) or returns true and updates the public owner to the provided address; additionally, setOwner never modifies contract balance.

property_summary: Calling setOwner never changes the contract balance; if the call succeeds it returns true and owner equals the provided address, otherwise owner remains whatever it was before the call.

If setOwner is called by anyone, then after the call (whether it reverted or not) the public owner variable is either unchanged or equal to the provided _owner; additionally, setOwner never creates or destroys Ether in C (address(c).balance unchanged).
If setOwner succeeds, it returns true and sets owner to the provided address; if it reverts then owner remains equal to the pre-call owner (i.e., owner changes iff call succeeds).
